### 2026-10-18 – I decided to handdraw the blueprints of my build ,as using computer software, takes too long, i have to pay for good software, and in my opinion, handdraw looks good, based on experience. I also decid

**3.5h**

I decided to handdraw the blueprints of my build ,as using computer software, takes too long, i have to pay for good software, and in my opinion, handdraw looks good, based on experience. I also decided for the Cad model, to not add a roof as incase anyone would like to decorate it, so anyone cad add furniture, or miniature people or pets or what not in it. I originally thought of adding lighting, but i dont have the time, or energy, to do it, so i may add it a different time. For anyone who is wondering where my blueprint sources came from, heres the image i found on facebook which i used as reference:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ICfGl9WlsUCo0vTQqywfbnXlt0PfIwC1/0ec78320743a46f0650bc0bcf8ad20ebc1ffe93b20eea4652d492998e047857c.png)
